name: Sankaty Head (Armstrong's moorland links on Nantucket's east end)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Sankaty Head Golf Club, Siasconset, Nantucket, from NAIP and the course's descriptions (LINKS Magazine: sandy, gravelly, treeless, windswept and firm; Urbina's restoration returned bluegrass to native fescue and cleared scrub oak between fairways): firm green fairways and greens; a mown band; then blond, wind-combed fescue (F0-F2), paler and yellower than Eastward Ho!'s copper heath; pale island sand; the grey-blue Atlantic; dark scrub and bayberry (G0-G2); 'Sconset lawns out of bounds (L0-L2). Trees in assets-src/trees_sankaty_head.py: Japanese black pine and pitch pine windbreaks, red cedar, scrub oak and bayberry. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
